subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should the fix invalidate all pre-marker persisted plugin-registry caches once, rather than infer legacy orphan rows from ambiguous unmarked diagnostics?
rationale: The submitted marker solves future writes but cannot distinguish old orphan rows from other legacy diagnostics without a compatibility boundary; that choice determines whether existing installations recover safely without perpetual rediscovery.

options.title: Invalidate the old registry cache once
options.body: Add an explicit cache-generation or narrow migration boundary so pre-marker persisted indexes are re-derived, then retain code-based detection for future orphan diagnostics.

options.title: Infer the legacy shape at runtime
options.body: Define and test a sufficiently precise legacy diagnostic contract before treating unmarked rows as stale, accepting the risk of false-positive rediscovery if that contract is too broad.

recommendation.title: Invalidate the old registry cache once
recommendation.body: Add an explicit cache-generation or narrow migration boundary so pre-marker persisted indexes are re-derived, then retain code-based detection for future orphan diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current and prior proposed implementations and can update the branch once the compatibility boundary is selected.
